nodes.label: Face-Recognition Attendance Design Spec
nodes.rationale: Design spec defining an attendance feature that records one event per confidently recognized tracked appearance in realtime and uploaded-video workflows, distinct from existing sampling/debug recognition logs.

nodes.label: config/settings.py
nodes.rationale: Configuration module; planned to gain VOICE_EMBEDDING_MODEL, VOICE_EMBEDDING_DIM, VOICE_MATCH_THRESHOLD, VOICE_AMBIGUITY_MARGIN, VOICE_CLUSTER_DISTANCE_THRESHOLD, WHISPER_LANGUAGE, WHISPER_INITIAL_PROMPT, and UNKNOWN_VOICES_DIR.

nodes.label: transcription_core.py
nodes.rationale: Whisper transcription module; planned to be modified to gate transcription on Silero VAD speech spans and wire in the voice_core diarizer.

nodes.label: transcribe_with_diarization
nodes.rationale: Whisper transcription function; planned modification gates decoding on VAD speech regions (dropping silence hallucinations), sets condition_on_previous_text=False and word_timestamps=True, and wires in the voice_core diarizer callback.

nodes.label: audio_core.py
nodes.rationale: Audio processing module providing detect_speech_segments (Silero VAD), read_wav_pcm, SAMPLE_RATE, and FRAME_BYTES; consumed by both transcription_core and voice_core.

nodes.label: voice_core.py
nodes.rationale: New module for SpeechBrain ECAPA-TDNN speaker embedding extraction, voiceprint matching with ambiguity margin, and per-meeting diarization clustering via scipy hierarchical clustering.

nodes.label: diarize_meeting_audio
nodes.rationale: Clusters VAD speech regions into speakers using scipy hierarchical agglomerative clustering (cosine distance, average linkage); labels clusters with enrolled person names or 'Unknown Speaker N'; returns (label, start, end) tuples for transcription_core.

nodes.label: extract_voice_embedding
nodes.rationale: Extracts a 192-dim L2-normalized float32 speaker embedding from raw PCM16 mono audio using SpeechBrain ECAPA-TDNN; returns None for empty/too-short audio or on model failure.

nodes.label: match_voice_embedding
nodes.rationale: Linear-scan cosine similarity match against all enrolled voiceprints; enforces VOICE_MATCH_THRESHOLD (0.72) and VOICE_AMBIGUITY_MARGIN (0.05) to reject ambiguous matches; mirrors face_core.FaceIndex.search behavior.

nodes.label: database.py
nodes.rationale: Relational database layer; planned to gain voice_embeddings, unknown_voices, and unknown_voice_samples tables with full CRUD for voice enrollment and resolution.

nodes.label: face_core.py
nodes.rationale: Face recognition core module; serves as the architectural pattern that voice_core.py mirrors (fixed-dim L2-normalized embeddings, cosine similarity matching with ambiguity margin).

nodes.label: GPU Requirements
nodes.rationale: Defines the GPU-accelerated dependency set, swapping in uniface[gpu], onnxruntime-gpu, and CUDA-enabled torch with nvidia-cublas/cudnn packages.

nodes.label: CPU Requirements
nodes.rationale: Defines the CPU-only dependency set for the project, including uniface[cpu], onnxruntime, torch, whisper, speechbrain, and qdrant-client.

nodes.label: Active Speaker Estimation
nodes.rationale: Application logic combining VAD timing and FaceMesh lip motion to estimate which visible face is speaking; voice match serves as fallback confirmation only when face recognition is absent or low-confidence.

nodes.label: Attendance Tracking
nodes.rationale: Records a known person when the video or realtime pipeline recognizes their face with sufficient confidence; stored in PostgreSQL; voice activity or unknown face alone is insufficient.

nodes.label: Face Recognition
nodes.rationale: Pipeline combining UniFace SCRFD detection, ArcFace 512-dim embedding, FaceMesh landmarks, and Qdrant vector search for identity matching with cosine similarity and confidence threshold.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL
nodes.rationale: Primary relational database for persons, enrollments, transcripts, attendance, and log records; Alembic manages schema; SQLite retained only as legacy import source.

nodes.label: Qdrant Vector Database
nodes.rationale: Vector search store for face and voice embeddings; collections initialized from environment settings; stores vectors and non-sensitive lookup metadata, not media files.

nodes.label: Silero VAD
nodes.rationale: Speech activity detection model; finds speech regions in audio for VAD-gated transcription and active-speaker estimation; does not generate transcript text.

nodes.label: SpeechBrain ECAPA-TDNN
nodes.rationale: Speaker embedding model (spkrec-ecapa-voxceleb) producing 192-dim voice representations for speaker clustering and identity matching.

nodes.label: Transcription
nodes.rationale: OpenAI Whisper (small) transcription gated by Silero VAD speech regions; supports multilingual mode, glossary-based initial prompts, and optional LLM refinement for readable output.

nodes.label: UniFace
nodes.rationale: Face detection (SCRFD), recognition (ArcFace), and landmark (FaceMesh) model suite; CPU and GPU variants available via uniface[cpu] and uniface[gpu].

nodes.label: Voice Recognition / Speaker Identification
nodes.rationale: Pipeline using SpeechBrain ECAPA-TDNN 192-dim embeddings, cosine similarity matching with quality-filtered enrollment samples, ambiguity margin, and minimum identity duration; independent from face enrollment.

nodes.label: OpenAI Whisper
nodes.rationale: Speech-to-text model (small) for transcription; uses transcribe mode to retain spoken language; does not identify speakers.

nodes.label: Face and Voice Recognition README
nodes.rationale: Primary project documentation describing architecture, components, setup, and workflow for the FaceAndVoiceRecV2 Streamlit application.

nodes.label: Voice Diarization and Recognition Implementation Plan
nodes.norm_label: voice diarization and recognition implementation plan
nodes.rationale: Design plan to add SpeechBrain ECAPA-TDNN speaker embeddings, per-meeting diarization clustering, and voiceprint matching against enrolled identities.

nodes.label: config/settings.py
nodes.rationale: TRANSCRIPT_REFINEMENT_API added here: ollama (default, unchanged) or openai; value is trimmed and case-insensitive; any other value raises ValueError naming the setting and allowed values.

nodes.label: app/pages/transcripts.py
nodes.rationale: Refine button, spinner, and disabled-state hint use the configured local label instead of always saying Ollama.

nodes.label: _provider_caption
nodes.rationale: _provider_caption("openai:<model>") returns Local OpenAI-compatible: <model>.

nodes.label: _parse_structured_response
nodes.rationale: Already handles fenced JSON, so the new client only needs to strip a leading think block before delegating to it.

nodes.label: _post_openai_compatible_chat
nodes.rationale: New client added next to _post_ollama_chat; sends POST {TRANSCRIPT_REFINEMENT_URL}/v1/chat/completions with no auth header, temperature 0, stream false, and a json_schema response_format named transcript_refinement; strips a leading think block before parsing.

nodes.label: _refine_with_provider
nodes.rationale: Routes openai to the new client with model TRANSCRIPT_REFINEMENT_MODEL; unknown providers still raise ValueError.

nodes.label: transcription_core module
nodes.rationale: Accepts openai as a provider so the saved refinement method becomes openai:<model>; historical ollama:<model> methods remain unchanged.

nodes.label: llama-server /v1/chat/completions endpoint
nodes.rationale: llama-server does not provide Ollama's native /api/chat endpoint; it provides the OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions endpoint, which is why a second client is needed.

nodes.label: OpenAI-Compatible Local Transcript Refinement Design
nodes.rationale: Allow the local transcript refiner to use a llama-server (llama.cpp) instance on another machine while keeping Ollama as the default; the default remote example uses unencrypted HTTP on a LAN, so transcript text crosses the network in clear text and the endpoint must be trusted.

nodes.label: README
nodes.rationale: Must document TRANSCRIPT_REFINEMENT_API, add a llama-server example, update the behavior list, and restate that the endpoint must be trusted.

nodes.label: Appearance Identity Tuple (source, source_ref, track_id, person_id)
nodes.norm_label: appearance identity tuple (source, source_ref, track_id, person_id)
nodes.rationale: Identifies a tracked appearance; the first eligible observation for a track creates an event and repeated observations of the same person/track/source do not create more events.

nodes.label: attendance_events Table
nodes.rationale: Existing recognition logs are sampling/debug records (repeated realtime samples, per-frame video records) unsuitable as attendance rows without event-level filtering and stable source identity; a separate table with uniqueness on (source, source_ref, track_id, person_id) makes repeated observations idempotent within a source run. Realtime rows carry UTC wall-clock observed_at_utc; video rows carry media_offset_ms with null calendar timestamp to avoid inventing a recording date for historical footage.

nodes.label: Attendance Streamlit Tab
nodes.rationale: New tab in existing Streamlit navigation with a Realtime/Uploaded-video source selector; realtime mode uses inclusive machine-local datetimes (default last 24h, 'Up to now' on by default) converted to UTC, video mode requires one normalized-path video selection; both modes keep a person filter and export exactly the selected rows.

nodes.label: audio_logs Table
nodes.rationale: Retained for its current diagnostic purpose; attendance is stored separately from it.

nodes.label: Attendance CSV Export
nodes.rationale: Exports exactly the selected source, time interval, and person rows; spreadsheet exports are protected by escaping formula-leading text cells; video clip offsets are not presented as dates.

nodes.label: init_db() Migration
nodes.rationale: Existing idempotent migration pattern used to add the attendance_events table.

nodes.label: person_id (persistent person identifier)
nodes.rationale: Links to a known person in the database; only observations with person_id set and confidence at/above threshold are eligible.

nodes.label: Realtime Recognition Workflow
nodes.rationale: Generates a fresh run ID when a camera recognition process starts and records eligible tracks once during that run; timestamps are UTC wall-clock values converted from the pipeline's monotonic clock.

nodes.label: recognition_logs Table
nodes.rationale: Retained for its current diagnostic purpose; attendance is stored separately from it.

nodes.label: config.RECOGNITION_THRESHOLD
nodes.rationale: Existing threshold (currently 0.70) reused for attendance eligibility; unknown or below-threshold faces are not recorded, and historical rows are not hidden if the threshold is later changed.

nodes.label: source_ref (run ID or normalized video path)
nodes.norm_label: source_ref (run id or normalized video path)
nodes.rationale: A generated realtime run ID or a normalized absolute uploaded-video path; moving or renaming the video creates a different source reference.

nodes.label: track_id (run-local track identifier)
nodes.rationale: Local to a run/video and separates distinct tracked appearances; a lost-and-reacquired person as a new track is a new appearance.

nodes.label: Uploaded-Video Processing Workflow
nodes.rationale: Collects the first eligible recognition per track while processing; replaces rows for the normalized video path transactionally only after the pipeline completes successfully, keeping prior rows intact on failure.

nodes.label: app/main.py
nodes.rationale: Currently imports all seven page modules at module load and invokes every page renderer under st.tabs on each rerun; the design changes it to import no page modules at module scope and defer Torch/ONNX runtime probe until explicitly requested.

nodes.label: _DB_LOCK
nodes.rationale: Existing process-level lock that previously protected get_conn() only; the design extends it to cover the full init_db() initialization to serialize with get_conn() in the same process.

nodes.label: FaceIndex Cached Getter
nodes.rationale: Stays behind its existing cached getter and is reached only when the Face Database tab is selected, deferring model creation until needed.

nodes.label: get_runtime_status()
nodes.rationale: Imports Torch when called; currently invoked before tab rendering on every rerun; the design defers it behind an explicit Check runtime action and caches the result in st.session_state to avoid re-probing.

nodes.label: init_db()
nodes.rationale: Holds _DB_LOCK across initialization, uses a bounded 30-second SQLite timeout with matching PRAGMA busy_timeout, sets WAL mode before the schema transaction, and uses BEGIN IMMEDIATE to serialize competing app/realtime processes and prevent partial schema updates; commits once on success, rolls back and re-raises on failure.

nodes.label: requirements.txt
nodes.rationale: Supports Streamlit 1.40+, which is below the 1.64.0 version that exposes the stateful st.tabs API, necessitating an eager compatibility fallback.

nodes.label: st.session_state
nodes.rationale: Stores the runtime status result after the explicit Check runtime action so subsequent reruns do not re-probe Torch/ONNX.

nodes.label: client.showSidebarNavigation
nodes.rationale: Set to False before constructing navigation to prevent the conventional app/pages/ directory from creating duplicate sidebar links.

nodes.label: st.tabs (Stateful API)
nodes.rationale: Used with on_change='rerun' and key when supported (Streamlit 1.64.0); each page is imported only on first selection and active/previously visited pages are re-rendered to preserve widget state; an eager compatibility fallback is required for Streamlit versions without the stateful API (1.40+ floor).

nodes.label: transcription_segments Table
nodes.rationale: Subject of the compatibility backfill UPDATE transcription_segments SET original_text=text WHERE original_text IS NULL; no schema changes are part of the lazy-load work.

nodes.label: BEGIN IMMEDIATE
nodes.rationale: Used before schema inspection, DDL, and compatibility backfills to acquire a write lock early, preventing partial schema updates and serializing competing processes.

nodes.label: Legacy File/Path Migration
nodes.rationale: Serialized across processes with a persistent SQLite lock database under the target data/ root; preflight walks every source descendant, rejects symlinks and symlink ancestors, checks same-filesystem constraints, and rejects conflicts before any move; marker temp files use unique names and are published without replacing an existing marker, making concurrent migration retryable without overwriting unrelated data.

nodes.label: SQLite WAL Mode
nodes.rationale: Set before beginning the schema transaction as part of the initialization locking strategy to allow concurrent readers during writes.

nodes.label: process_meeting_transcription()
nodes.rationale: Existing Whisper transcription path; the design threads an optional subtitle_word_callback through it without changing existing return values or MP3 behavior.

nodes.label: process_video_pipeline()
nodes.rationale: Existing pipeline that writes an annotated video-only intermediate via OpenCV VideoWriter and extracts source audio to a temporary WAV for VAD/speaker attribution, then deletes the WAV.

nodes.label: SubtitleWord
nodes.rationale: Small immutable data type in a focused subtitle module; when Whisper word timings are missing/unreliable, segment text is split into whitespace-delimited words and the segment interval is distributed proportionally to character count, keeping captions short without another ASR pass.

nodes.label: subtitle_word_callback
nodes.rationale: Optional callback threaded through process_meeting_transcription() to transcribe_with_diarization(); does not change existing transcription return values or MP3 behavior.

nodes.label: Annotated Video-Only Intermediate
nodes.rationale: Produced by process_video_pipeline() via OpenCV VideoWriter; serves as Input 0 for the FFmpeg burn-in step; if subtitle rendering fails, the same source-audio mux runs without the subtitle filter on this intermediate.

nodes.label: Temporary ASS Subtitle File
nodes.rationale: Uses a high-contrast bottom-aligned style with a fixed 1920x1080 script resolution and explicit line breaks so font size is stable and libass does not add extra wrapped lines; ASS text renders transcript backslashes/braces literally and normalizes CR/LF to prevent formatting injection.

nodes.label: Two-line Subtitle Cue Builder
nodes.rationale: Groups consecutive records only when speaker labels match and inter-record gap is within a configurable subtitle gap; wraps on word boundaries to no more than two explicit lines targeting 42 characters per line for readability; splits on speaker changes; long individual words are not split; empty text and non-positive intervals are discarded.

nodes.label: FFmpeg Burn-in and Source-Audio Mux
nodes.rationale: Tries audio stream-copy first; if the source audio codec cannot be muxed into MP4, retries with AAC encoding while retaining the same timestamps/content; subtitle path is converted to FFmpeg filter syntax with forward slashes and escaped filter-special characters; filter expression passed as a subprocess argument without a shell.

nodes.label: Tracked MP4 (Final Output)
nodes.rationale: Final output written to a temporary path outside the tracked output folder and atomically replaces the tracked output only on success; on failure, the annotated silent video or audio-muxed intermediate is preserved at the tracked-output path.

nodes.label: Speaker-Attributed Word Timings
nodes.rationale: Collected through the optional callback during a single Whisper pass; when timings are missing/unreliable, proportional estimates across the segment interval are used instead of a second ASR pass.

nodes.label: frame_pipeline.py
nodes.rationale: New module providing a generic three-threaded read/process/write pipeline helper with bounded or drop-oldest queues and shared exception propagation.

nodes.label: run_threaded_pipeline
nodes.rationale: Generic function running read_frame -> process_frame -> write_frame across three daemon threads connected by two queue.Queue instances; supports blocking (maxsize=8) and drop-oldest (maxsize=1) modes; raises first stage exception after all threads join.

nodes.label: realtime.py
nodes.rationale: Live camera recognition pipeline; planned to be refactored to use run_threaded_pipeline with drop-oldest queues (maxsize=1) to prioritize the newest frame.

nodes.label: video_processor.py
nodes.rationale: Offline video processing pipeline; planned to be refactored to use run_threaded_pipeline with blocking queues (maxsize=8) to preserve all frames.

nodes.label: process_video_pipeline
nodes.rationale: Offline video processing entry point; planned refactor moves the per-frame body into a _process callable supplied to run_threaded_pipeline with blocking queues to guarantee output frame count equals input frame count.

nodes.label: PipelineErrorBox
nodes.rationale: Thread-safe single-slot holder for the first exception raised by any pipeline stage; uses threading.Lock to ensure only the first exception is recorded.

nodes.label: Threaded Pipeline Architecture
nodes.rationale: Three-thread (reader/compute/writer) pattern with queue-based inter-stage communication designed to overlap CPU I/O with GPU inference; blocking mode for offline (no frame loss), drop-oldest mode for realtime (newest frame priority).

nodes.label: GPU Utilization Pipeline Implementation Plan
nodes.rationale: Design plan to overlap CPU decode/encode with GPU inference by splitting video and realtime pipelines into reader/compute/writer threads connected by queues.

nodes.label: docker-compose.linux-devices.yml
nodes.rationale: Docker Compose override for Linux hosts exposing /dev/video0 and /dev/snd to the container; code review flagged medium-severity risks from broad device exposure.

nodes.label: face_backend.py
nodes.rationale: Face backend module implementing a lazy singleton with double-checked locking (threading.Lock) for UniFaceBackend; code review confirmed correct concurrency pattern.

nodes.label: get_face_backend
nodes.rationale: Lazy singleton accessor for UniFaceBackend using double-checked locking with threading.Lock; code review confirmed correct pattern with retry-on-exception semantics.

nodes.label: Qwen3.8 Code Review Report
nodes.rationale: Automated code review of 114 files in FaceAndVoiceRecV2; identified medium-severity device exposure risks in docker-compose and a low-severity test robustness concern.
